subject: PO token handoff and spend threshold remap — Solstice onboarding
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@solstice-systems.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Cole <timothy.cole@solstice-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO request and spend guidance

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. Per our conversation we need a final PO to start the onboarding process for Solstice Systems. Attached is the vendor onboarding form and our initial invoice breakdown. A couple of things we wanted to confirm:

- Requested spend band: $50,000 (first quarter) — we submitted itemized lines for services and one-time setup.
- Can you provision a provisional PO token so our procurement and billing team can tie invoices while the SOW is routing?
- We noticed earlier you use a combined ledger token and separate SKU line mapping. Please advise the required format for "line_code" so our invoices map cleanly.

Attachments: Solstice_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf, solstice_lineitems_v1.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
Solstice Systems

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@solstice-systems.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO request and spend guidance

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the form and the line-item spreadsheet. Looping in Ben (vendor ops) and Karthik (finance/compliance) to get PO tokened and confirm spend bucket. Quick notes:

- We can issue a provisional purchase token today to unblock invoices. That token will be replaced by the formal PO number once legal signs the SOW.
- Our platform requires a primary "purchase_ref" (format: PON-YYYYMMDD-[VENDOR_CODE]-####) and then a per-line "line_code" (e.g., LC-001, LC-002) to map to ledger buckets.
- I see the spreadsheet has combined setup + services on line 1 — to avoid misallocation please split setup (one-time) and recurring services into separate lines.
- Also confirm the spend cap. You requested $50k but procurement shows a provisional cap of $150k from the initial request — can you confirm the correct ceiling?

If you can send the revised line items we will:
1) Issue a provisional token (PXT-XXXX) today.
2) Re-issue the formal PO with correct spend cap after SOW countersign.

Sofia
Sr. Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@solstice-systems.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO request and spend guidance

Marta / Sofia —

Quick update from vendor ops/finance: we can provision a working PO token now (PXT-20270601-SS-01) so AP can apply invoices, but we will need a corrected line break-down to set up ledger mapping. Two operational items:

- Current provisional cap in the system is $150,000 — that came in from an earlier procurement placeholder. We will not enforce that amount against billing, but until you confirm the $50,000 cap we will leave the provisioning at $150k to avoid a hard stop on early invoices.
- For the final PO, we need each invoice line to include: 
  * description
  * qty
  * unit_price
  * line_code (LC-###)
  * cost_center (if you want it applied to a specific bucket)

I've attached a simple template that maps the Redwood ledger fields to the columns in your spreadsheet. Please return the updated sheet and we'll re-run the mapping.

Attachments: solstice_lineitems_v1.xlsx (annotated)

Ben Carter
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@solstice-systems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Cole <timothy.cole@solstice-systems.com>, accounts-payable@solstice-systems.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO request and spend guidance

Thanks Ben — attached is an updated line-item sheet that splits the one-time setup and recurring services (column "line_type" added). We also explicitly set the first-quarter spend to $50,000.

Notes:
- We had a pre-approval placeholder for $150k because our CFO requested flexible buffer during contract discussions — that should not be the active cap. Please set the formal cap to $50k for Q3 invoicing.
- Line codes: we added LC-101 for setup, LC-102..104 for the three service tiers.

Can you confirm when the provisional token will be visible to our AP team? AP is standing by to apply the first milestone invoice.

Updated attachment: solstice_lineitems_v2.xlsx

Best,
Marta

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@solstice-systems.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO token handoff and spend threshold remap

Hi all —

Confirmed: I asked ops to re-issue the working token and re-run the line mapping. Summary of actions taken:

- Provisional token issued: PXT-20270601-SS-01 (visible to Solstice AP as of 2027-06-03 16:15 PDT).
- Formal PO reissued with corrected cap and lines: Purchase Ref PON-20270601-SS-4578. Spend cap set to $50,000 for Q3 as requested.
- Line mapping applied: LC-101 (one-time setup) -> ledger 4301, LC-102..104 -> ledger 5202.
- DocuSign SOW routing link: https://app.docusign.com/embedded/sign/abc123-solstice-sow (SOW needs final signature to keep the PO permanent).

Attachments: po_reissue_confirmation.txt (contains PON and cap details)

Next steps for Solstice AP: please submit your milestone invoice referencing PXT-20270601-SS-01 so we can process the first payment. Once the SOW is signed we will swap the provisional token for PON-20270601-SS-4578 in all ledger reports.

If anything appears off on your end (invoices not matching ledger lines), ping Ben and Karthik — they will coordinate any quick remaps.

Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference
